Brampton Plan (Official Plan) Waterbodies include lakes, ponds, reservoirs, stormwater management facilities, and other permanent surface water features. These areas contribute to watershed health, flood management, ecological function, and the visual and recreational character of the city.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
